title: Product Designer
description: SigmaMD aims to make a meaningful contribution to the world by changing the way people manage their health. Our growing engineering and product team has deep expertise in consumer tech. We are combining our diverse backgrounds to innovate in Digital Health.Our goal is to make millions of lives healthier by using technology. We strive to empower patients to take control of their health care and help clinicians better treat them. To achieve this vision we need an outstanding and passionate Product Designer to take on the following responsibilities:Contribute to high-level product thinking while also developing interaction flows, mockups, and prototypes. Collaborate in a cross-functional team to understand user needs and business goals, and translate them into intuitive and effective product designs. Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups to communicate design concepts and gather feedback. Advocate for the needs and preferences of both doctors and patients by conducting user research and gathering feedback from both groups, and incorporating their insights into the design process to ensure the product meets the needs of all stakeholders. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, design best practices, and the latest design tools and technologies to ensure the team is delivering high-quality, cutting-edge products.This person should share our core values of teamwork, empathy, and innovation. Ideally, they have the following:Know how to define a repeatable and shareable design process that encourages collaboration between design, product, and engineering teams. Ask questions that build or help to clarify the problem statement and ensure that you maintain user focus and empathy. Explore and refine concepts, then narrow to the best solution, weighing technical feasibility and scope with your team. Create and maintain UX and UI deliverables including information architecture, wireframes, prototypes, style guides, micro interaction specifications, and pattern libraries. Influence the product vision leading and participating in research, focused on both the intangibles (emotional needs) and tangibles (functional needs).. Champion usability testing within your product team, capture the team's assumptions, identify the correct test methodology to use, document results, communicate actionable feedback and findings back to the team. Communicate your design rationale to project stakeholders and use data to defend your design choices.Required Skills 2+ years of product design experience (including equivalent UI and UX focused role). Able to provide samples of work that show creative solutions to complex products, strong visual design, and information architecture. A strong understanding of the entire product development process, from research and problem solving through to detailed UI and visual design. Experience with Figma. Understand how modern technologies are used with design. Believe that product and design decisions are inextricably linked. Enjoy shipping small, quick experiments to explore and validate your ideas. Know how to balance the user experience with technical and business requirements. Able to communicate effectively with all stakeholders. Speak KPIs, OKRs and understand how to rely on data to support your work. Not afraid to learn new things to take on a problem. Are a self-starter who works proactively to solve problems and bring clarity to ambiguity Facilitate both design-focused and cross-functional sessions with ease, relying on your knowledge of facilitation tools and techniquesDesired Skills Have an understanding of front end technologies such as HTML and CSS. Experience with Jira and Confluence. Prior experience in a design related role at a startup. Experience with digital health or relatable areas. Experience working with mobile apps.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End EngineerLocation:Brazil (Remote)About Sphise TechnologiesSphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire aSenior Front End Engineer.Role OverviewWe are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, technical ownership, and architectural judgment. This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.Key Responsibilities - Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud using modern JavaScript frameworks. - Build production-grade applications using Next.Js, with deployment targets such as Vercel or Netlify. - Integrate front-end applications with: -OrderCloud APIs -Sitecore DXP APIs -Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services - Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end implementations. - Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable for a growing team. - Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API contracts and realistic implementation. - Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases. - Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and deployment strategy. - Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.Required Qualifications - 5+ years of professional front-end development experience. - Strong hands-on experience with Next.Js and React in production environments. - Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce platforms. - Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture: -SSR, SSG, ISR -Client vs server components -State management patterns - Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. - Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs. - Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify. - Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development. - Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for future scale.Preferred Experience - Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.G., Cursor + Claude) to: -Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.
-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for modern front-end applications.
-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production- ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time. - Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms. - Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications. - Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‐end frameworks such as AngularJS or similar React‐like ecosystems.Benefits Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
TheProject Managerin our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are deliveredon time, within scope, and within budget. This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managingmultiple projectsor client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.G.,Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ). Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities. Team Leadership & Coordination:Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site andremote/hybrid work environments. Budget & Risk Management:Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively;
implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.G., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution. Stakeholder Communication:Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Quality Assurance & Delivery:Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs. Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement:Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emergingindustry trends(likeAI integration in project management ,DevSecOps, and newcollaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managingmultiple full project lifecycles, with at least several projects related toIT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. Agile/Other Certs:Additional certifications likeCertified Scrum Master (CSM)orITIL Foundationare beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

description: About Us BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.What You'll Do As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.More specifically, in this role you will: Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs) Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updatesWhat We're Looking For 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta) 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients) Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationshipsWhat This Role Is NOT This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.Time Commitment Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.Pay $3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

Descrição da vaga AHelbor Empreendimentos S.A.É uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado daB3, a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade. Estamos em busca de um(a)Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESGpara integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia. A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado. Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado. Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
Apoiar o acompanhamentode temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
Apoiar na elaboração derelatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;

Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
Excel e PowerPoint em nível avançado;
Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal.Informações adicionais O que nós oferecemos:Vale Alimentação Vale Refeição Assistência Médica Assistência odontológica Participação nos Resultados Wellhub Zenklub Espaço de descompressão equipado com vídeo games, ping pong e espaço para alimentaçãoOnde estamos: Faria Lima - SP

title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow | Especialista Técnico De Aplicações
description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD): O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar: Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema. Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação. Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações. Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada. Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações. Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders. Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos. Qualificações e RequisitosQualificações essenciais
- Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada
- Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)
- Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer
- Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicosCompetências-chave 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejávelOutras habilidades e competências Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Research Engineer, Rl Environments
description:
About Turing Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.The Role We are looking for aResearch Engineer, RL Environmentsto help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients. This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.What You'll Do: 1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria. Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals. Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming. Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions. Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring. Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities. Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift. When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups. Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals. Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.Who We're Looking For: 1. Required Qualifications 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially. Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure. Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints. Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments. Python proficiency required;
comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred. Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.2. Highly valued experience Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods. Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems. Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis. Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints. Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.Why Turing Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models. Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve. Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.Values: We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. We work at Start-Up Speed:We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection We are Al forward:We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.Advantages of joining Turing: Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
5 days a week) Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience) Competitive compensation Flexible working hoursDon't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Software Architect
description:
Somos aVortigo- nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital. Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global. Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais. Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso? Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:Principais Responsabilidades: - Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;
- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;
- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;
- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;
- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;
- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.Habilidades Técnicas: - Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);
- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);
- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);
- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.Js, Angular, Next.Js);
- Experiência em .NET edesenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);
- Capacidade de aplicarpadrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);
- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);
- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);
- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);
- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;
- Habilidade em liderardecisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.O que você encontra aqui: Remote First– Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar. Comunidades Técnicas– Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos. Cultura de Feedback– Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI). title: Senior Front End Engineer

Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Software Engineer

Role Overview We are looking for a hands‐on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making. Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI. Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making;
ensure usability, consistency, and performance. Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows. Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement. Quality & Reliability: Perform end‐to‐end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services;
monitor performance anditerate based on feedback. Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas. Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python. Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation. Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages). Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming). Hands‐on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.G., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing). Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus. Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.Tech Stack (Indicative) Languages: Java, Python, C++ Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization Frontend: Component‐based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows) Testing: Unit, integration, E2E;
CI/CD pipelines Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuningWhat We're Looking For Strong problem‐solving skills and a data‐driven mindset. Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs. Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support. Excellent collaboration with cross‐functional partners and stakeholders.Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope TheFreight Desk Manageris a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on theLATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion:Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership:Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance:Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cardsacross a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing:Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiativesfor logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture:Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight:Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering:Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management:Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience:Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise:Deep knowledge of theLATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery:Proven track record inleading RFQsand managing complexlogistics supplier onboardingprocesses. Network Management:Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operational models. Technical Proficiency:Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership:Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education:Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages:Fluency inEnglishis essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education:MBA or Master's degree. Process Excellence:Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation:Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background:Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Arquiteto Sênior Sap Basis E Infraestrutura
description: Sobre a EmpresaVocê atuará como referência técnica em projetos estratégicos e ambientes de alta complexidade. Será responsável por impulsionar a evolução técnica do time, fortalecer o framework de conhecimento e certificações, além de apoiar iniciativas críticas e o time de Suporte (MS).Sobre o PapelProcuramos um(a) profissional com visão de arquitetura, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e forte interesse em tecnologias emergentes como SAP BTP, IA, SAP Activate e integrações com Azure, AWS e GCP.ResponsabilidadesLiderar iniciativas técnicas SAP Basis, incluindo migrações (S/4HANA, ECC, PI/PO, etc), upgrades e projetos críticos em ambientes Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP). Conduzir assessments técnicos e de performance (tunning, banco de dados, arquitetura, etc) e definir recomendações de otimização. Atuar como referência técnica e ponto de escalonamento, oferecendo suporte Nível 3 e 4, inclusive em situações de crise (war rooms) em ambientes complexos. Desenvolver e manter arquitetura SAP, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, alta disponibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas da SAP e dos hyperscalers. Apoiar os times de suporte (Managed Services) e Projetos (Professional Services), incluindo manutenção, melhorias, auditorias, mudanças, atualizações e rotinas operacionais em SAP ECC, S/4 e RISE. Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis. Promover inovação e aprendizagem contínua, pesquisando novas tecnologias (IA, BTP, ALM, accelerators Azure/AWS/GCP) e disseminando conhecimento para o time.QualificaçõesGraduação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada. Proficiência avançada em português, e espanhol (intermediário). Experiência Sênior em SAP Basis.Habilidades NecessáriasCertificações: (certificação direta pela SAP): SAP OS/DB Migration, SAP Technology Consultant Expert, SAP HANA 2.0, SAP Certified Application Professional, Certificações SAP Solution Consultant (ex.: BTP, Implementation Consultant, etc.). Liderança técnica e arquitetura SAP: Experiência em gestão de crises, condução de projetos complexos, desenho/arquitetura de soluções e liderança de iniciativas multidisciplinares, incluindo migração e implementação de SAP S/4HANA (Public e Private Cloud) e RISE. Administração e otimização de ambientes SAP: Sólida atuação em upgrades (NetWeaver, Support Packages via SUM), cópias homogêneas e heterogêneas, migração de dados e troubleshooting em ambientes complexos e sob pressão. Base técnica robusta: Conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2), sistemas operacionais (SUSE) e domínio de administração de sistemas SAP. Ferramentas, idiomas e mindset: Experiência com ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Grafana e Dynatrace, além de forte compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e evolução tecnológica.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description: This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.Js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.Day to day, you'll be working on things like: Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the teamYou should have: 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this) Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar) Backend capability with Node.Js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcomeNice to have: Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms Familiarity with booking/reservation systems Experience leading or mentoring other engineers Apple Pay integration experienceWhy FlyMeOut: Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026 Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up Work directly with the founder on product and technical directionCompensation & Terms This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise. Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month) Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible) Health benefits: Not offered at this stage Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis Probation: 2 weeks Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM BrasilHow to Apply Send your resume towith the subject lineFMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Assistente Administrativo
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Atender às ocorrências operacionais relacionadas a ambientes da empresa, como vazamentos, falhas elétricas, problemas em vestiários, refeitório, banheiros, entre outros.
  • Acionar fornecedores de manutenção corretiva e acompanhar a execução dos serviços contratados.
  • Verificar no local a natureza do problema e registrar a ocorrência de forma adequada.
  • Conferir se os serviços foram realizados conforme combinado, observando prazos, qualidade e emissão da nota fiscal.
  • Utilizar o sistema de gestão de viagens corporativas para registrar, acompanhar e controlar solicitações, aprovações, reservas e prestação de contas.
  • Apoiar o controle das rotinas operacionais de Facilities, em interface com a equipe.
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento do transporte fretado, consumo no restaurante e funcionamento dos equipamentos e estruturas da unidade.
  • Manter registros atualizados em planilhas e relatórios simples de ocorrências e atendimentos realizados.
  • Apoiar o controle orçamentário da área, acompanhando os gastos mensais com serviços de Facilities e viagens, e comparando com o previsto.
  • Sinalizar ao Supervisor e a equipe, eventuais falhas ou desvios operacionais.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Médio Completo, desejável cursando Ensino Superior em Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento emPacote Office, principalmente Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA.
  • Desejável conhecimento na execução de atividades operacionais relacionadas aos serviços de Facilities como: viagens, hospedagens, combustíveis, táxi, locações de veículos (Frota), apoio quanto a solicitação dos materiais de limpeza e fardamentos, cadastros de fornecedores internos;
  • Vivência com o sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.

Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.

Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Sap S/4 Hana Brim Application Expert
description: ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices. Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams. Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging. Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting). Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects. Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities. Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.SELECTION CRITERIA Essential: Bachelor / master's degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries. Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA. Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles. Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology. Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications. Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated. Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timelineDesirable: SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM. Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions. Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS Office based/Remote with occasional international travel. Health and Safety accountability statements. Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.We are the ASSA ABLOY Group Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.As we welcome new people on board, it's important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.Required Skills & Experience - 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness. - Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting. - Hands-on experience with API testing (e.G., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%). - Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience - Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.Nice to Have Skills & Experience - Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms. - Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable). - Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).Day to Day - Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support. - Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines. - Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. - Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution. - Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar;
validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors. - Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness. - Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Senior Database Engineer / Lead Dba
description:

title: Application Security Engineer
description: We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ yearsof experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.Responsibilities: Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk. Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and proceduresRequired Experience: Excellent English communication skills 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10 Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.G., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.) Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineersDesired Experience: University degree or relevant industry experience Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines Familiarity with cloud security principles Experience with secure architecture reviews Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP Experience working in agile development environmentsAdditional Information: Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! title: Senior Database Administrator — Oltp & Olap Databases
description: Senior Database Administrator — OLTP & OLAP DatabasesLocation: Ukraine, Armenia, Moldova, Brazil(Remote)Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Data Engineer to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.About the RoleWe're hiring a Senior DBA to own the database layer across our production systems — OLTP relational databases as the operational store and an OLAP columnar database for analytics. Data flows between them via a CDC pipeline (Debezium → Kafka) managed by our infrastructure team. You'll own what's on both ends: schema design, data modeling, query performance, and analytics enablement. This is a high-ownership role. You'll be the technical authority on how our data is structured, how it performs, and how schema changes propagate safely from OLTP to OLAP stores. You'll work closely with application teams, data consumers, and the infrastructure team that operates the CDC pipeline.What You'll Own OLTP schema design: Data modeling, indexing strategies, migration planning, and performance tuning across multiple database clusters OLAP data modeling: Table design, materialized views, partitioning, and query optimization for analytics workloads Schema evolution: Coordinating schema changes with the infrastructure team to ensure safe propagation through the CDC pipeline Query performance: Profiling, optimization, and capacity planning across both OLTP and OLAP stores Data integrity: Validation, reconciliation, and monitoring to ensure consistency between OLTP and OLAP stores Technical leadership: Standards for schema management, review processes, mentoring, and cross-team collaborationTech Stack OLTP: Aurora MySQL 8.0 (multiple clusters, multi-AZ) OLAP: ClickHouse 25.X CDC Pipeline: Debezium 3.3.2 → Kafka 4.0 → ClickHouse Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3)Requirements 5+ years as a DBA or data engineer, 2+ in a senior/lead role Strong experience with OLTP relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) — schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication, migrations Strong experience with OLAP/columnar databases (ClickHouse, Vertica, Greenplum, Druid, Doris, or similar) — table design, materialized views, partitioning, query optimization Deep SQL expertise across both transactional and analytical query patterns Experience with schema migration strategies in environments with downstream consumers (CDC, ETL, replication) Familiarity with data consistency challenges between OLTP and OLAP systemsNice to Have Experience with Debezium or CDC systems — understanding how schema changes affect downstream pipelines Healthcare data or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC2) Data quality frameworks — validation, reconciliation, anomaly detection dbt, Airflow, or similar transformation/orchestration tools Performance benchmarking and capacity planning for OLAP databases Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora operational features — Parameter Groups, Performance Insights.Benefits: Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Integration Analyst
description: Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.Nosso Cliente Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho Atuar comoIntegration Analyst, apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento em nuvem. Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções utilizando.NET (C#), aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura,SOLIDeDesign Patterns. Criar, consumir e manterAPIs REST, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance. Implementar e sustentar soluções emAzure, utilizando serviços comoAzure Functions, App Services, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault e Application Insights. Trabalhar comintegração de sistemas entre múltiplas plataformas, incluindo ambientes corporativos e parceiros externos. Atuar comCI/CD, versionamento e automação utilizandoGitHubeGitHub Actions. Implementar e mantertestes automatizados(unitários e de integração). Garantirsegurança de APIs, utilizando padrões comoOAuth2eJWT. Produzir e manterdocumentação técnica clara e estruturada. Colaborar com times técnicos internos, stakeholders de negócio e parceiros externos em um ambiente corporativo global. Atuar em timesAgile, participando de cerimônias Scrum e/ou SAFe.O que você precisa ter Experiência mínima de4 anos com desenvolvimento .NET (C#). Vivência prática commetodologias ágeis(Scrum e/ou SAFe). Experiência comprovada comAzure Cloud, incluindo: Azure Functions Azure App Services Azure Storage Azure Key Vault Azure Service Bus Application Insights CertificaçãoAZ-104 – Azure Administrator. Experiência comcontrole de versão (Git/GitHub)epipelines de CI/CD(GitHub Actions). Experiência emintegração de sistemase desenvolvimento deAPIs REST. Conhecimento emsegurança de APIs(OAuth2, JWT). Vivência comtestes automatizados(unit e integration tests). Aplicação consistente deClean Code, Design Patterns e princípios SOLID. Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).Será um destaque no seu perfil Experiência comSalesforce, incluindo: Lightning Web Components (LWC) Apex Classes e Triggers Flows Experience Cloud (Builder) Integração com APIs externas Salesforce Commerce Cloud Flosum Conhecimento deobjetos padrão e customizadosno Salesforce. CertificaçãoAZ-204 – Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure. Experiência compublicação de aplicativos mobile(Apple Store e Google Play). Familiaridade comGoogle Firebase. Experiência prévia emambientes corporativos multinacionais. Certificações adicionais em integração ou tecnologias de desenvolvimento.Onde você vai trabalhar No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime100% Home Office, com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.
